content: 1. To open the diluent container, peel back the corner of the ADD-Vantage® diluent overwrap and remove the flexible diluent container. Some cloudiness of the plastic container may be observed due to moisture absorption during sterilization. This is normal and does not affect the quality or safety of the solution. The cloudiness will gradually diminish over time. 2. To assemble the vial and flexible diluent container using aseptic technique: Remove the protective covers from the top of the vial and the vial port on the diluent container. a. To remove the breakaway vial cap, swing the pull ring over the top of the vial and pull down to initiate the opening, then pull straight up to remove the cap. Do not access the vial with a syringe after the cap is removed. b. To remove the vial port cover, grasp the tab on the pull ring, pull upward to break the three tie strings, and then pull back to remove the cover. 3. Screw the vial into the vial port until it cannot be turned further. Ensure the vial is tightly secured to create a proper seal. This typically requires about a half-turn (180°) after the first audible click. Note that the clicking sound alone does not guarantee a seal; the vial must be turned as far as it will go. Once the vial is seated, do not attempt to remove it. 4. Recheck the vial to ensure it is tightly secured by attempting to turn it further in the direction of assembly. 5. Label the container appropriately. 6. To prepare the admixture: Gently squeeze the bottom of the diluent container to inflate the portion surrounding the end of the drug vial. With the other hand, push the drug vial down into the container, telescoping the walls of the container. Grasp the inner cap of the vial through the container walls. Pull the inner cap from the drug vial, ensuring the rubber stopper is removed, allowing the drug and diluent to mix. Mix the container contents thoroughly and use the solution within the specified time. 7. For preparation of administration using aseptic technique: Confirm that the vial contents have been activated and mixed. Check for leaks by firmly squeezing the container. If leaks are found, discard the unit as sterility may be compromised. Close the flow control clamp on the administration set. Remove the cover from the outlet port at the bottom of the container. Insert the piercing pin of the administration set into the port with a twisting motion until the pin is firmly seated. Refer to the full instructions on the administration set carton for additional details. Lift the free end of the hanger loop at the bottom of the vial, breaking the two tie strings. Bend the loop outward to lock it in the upright position, then suspend the container from the hanger. Squeeze and release the drip chamber to establish the proper fluid level. Open the flow control clamp and clear air from the set, then close the clamp. Attach the set to the venipuncture device. If the device is not indwelling, prime the set and perform venipuncture. Regulate the rate of administration using the flow control clamp. 8. Warning: Do not use the flexible container in series connections.
